function.name: page_length
function.description: Compile a complete LaTeX document and return {ok, fill, page_cap, target_fill, short_bullets}. `fill` is a decimal: 1.0 == exactly one page; 1.25 == 25% into a second page; 0.8 == 80% of one page. `target_fill` is the fill you should optimize toward (below page_cap, since a genuinely full page reads close to 1.0). On compile failure returns {ok: false, log_excerpt} with the pdflatex error. `short_bullets` lists bullets whose final wrapped line is mostly empty — each entry is {text, lines, last_line_fill}. Use this to fix compile errors and to decide whether to add, tighten, or drop content.
